Three screen frames are sent to Gemini; the title is checked with TMDB. Each question sends a fresh frame. Close private screens. Images are not saved to disk; chat text stays on this device. API/data charges may apply. Stop at any time from the notification.
Enter the Read Access Token from TMDB API settings (not the API key). It is encrypted on device.
No current frame is available. This answer uses conversation and general knowledge only; protected video cannot be analyzed.
